verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Online's first-party Intuit Intelligence chat lets users issue natural-language commands to create invoices, resolve anomalies, run payroll and generate reports, and to ask free-form questions about their finances. The evidence is vendor marketing copy only. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of command scope and limits (which actions can be fully executed versus only assisted), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the chat reliably operates the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Speed up business by telling Intuit Intelligence chat to create invoices, help resolve anomalies, run payroll, generate reports, estimate tax savings, and more.
Ask for the reports that matter most to your business—top expenses, sales trends, industry benchmarking—and get them instantly.
Ask anything—from “What’s driving my profit?” to “How are my invoices doing this month?”—and get instant, contextual answers in clear, concise language.
